channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Colin Kaepernick | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Colin Kaepernick from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Colin Kaepernick
item.description:
Warriors coach Steve Kerr:

“My sense a few years ago is that Kaepernick would eventually be viewed as a hero.”

Steve Kerr on Colin Kaepernick, Jun 9, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: LeBron James on Colin Kaepernick
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:LeBron James on Colin Kaepernick:

“I’m happy he won his suit, I hope he won a hell of a lot of money ... I hope the word of what he did lives on in not only American history but world history”

LeBron James on Colin Kaepernick, Feb 16, 2019. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Draymond Green on Colin Kaepernick
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Draymond Green on Colin Kaepernick:

“One thing I commend him for is he didn’t just kneel and stop. He’s kept going and he’s still going.”

Draymond Green on Colin Kaepernick, Nov 16, 2017. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Colin Kaepernick
item.description:
Stephen Curry:

“I respect everybody’s voice, everybody’s platform, and their opportunity and right to protest what they feel in their heart is something they want changed. I’ve said that plenty of times about Colin (Kaepernick). I respect what he’s doing. I respect the message that he’s fighting for, and I hope all the spotlight is on that particular message and the things we can do to make changes that are blatantly obvious we need change, so I hope going forward it’s not about who’s raising their fist, who’s kneeling, who’s standing, who’s doing this or that. It’s about what Colin and other guys – what the message is, and what we don’t want to stand for any more.”

Stephen Curry on Colin Kaepernick, Sep 27, 2016. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Colin Kaepernick
item.description:
Joe Freeman:Damian Lillard:

“I think what Colin Kaepernick is doing, it takes a strong person. He’s standing up for what he believes in, and rightfully so.”

Damian Lillard on Colin Kaepernick, Sep 26, 2016. Source: Twitter @BlazerFreeman.

item.title: LeBron James on Colin Kaepernick
item.description:
“That's who I am. That's what I believe in. But that doesn't mean I don't respect and don't agree with what Colin Kaepernick is doing.”

LeBron James on Colin Kaepernick, Sep 26, 2016. Source: TMZ.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Colin Kaepernick
item.description:
“Colin Kaepernick is standing up for what he believes in. That’s what makes our country so great, right? You have the luxury to do so. He was unapologetic about it and, in his defense, I don’t think he was trying to disrespect anyone. I think he was trying to get his point across. I’m all for anyone who wants to do that. As athletes, we have this huge platform. A lot of people are watching at all times. Sometimes it may not be what you do, they like. But if you feel like it’s gonna be impactful, that’s on you. I feel like everyone should stand up for what they believe.”

Kevin Durant on Colin Kaepernick, Sep 9, 2016. Source: San Jose Mercury-News.
